display_long_description:
✨ Key Features
■Full-Body Dodge Action
Only your head has a hit box! Duck, jump, and weave through obstacles using intuitive full-body movements.

■Full Hand Tracking Support
No controllers needed! Play seamlessly using intuitive hand gestures.

■3 Difficulty Levels (EASY / NORMAL / HARD)
From beginner-friendly EASY to the mind-bending HARD mode that will push your reflexes to the limit.

■VR / MR Modes
Switch freely between MR mode for safe play in your room and VR mode for total immersion.

🎮 Controls
【Controller Controls】
・Select Difficulty: Tilt Analog Stick Left / Right
・Start Game: A Button or X Button
・Toggle VR / MR: B Button or Y Button
・Toggle BGM (ON / OFF): Press Analog Stick Button
・Quit App: Hold Trigger Button

【Hand Tracking Controls (Hand Signs)】
・Select Difficulty: Extend Left Hand Forward (✋)
・Start Game: Right Hand Thumbs Up (👍)
・Toggle VR / MR: Right Hand Point Up (☝️)
・Toggle BGM (ON / OFF): Left Hand Point Up (☝️)
・Quit App: Left Hand Thumbs Up (👍)

💡 Tips & Rules
■Pro Tip: Focus Only on Your Head!
Only your head can trigger a game over. Cubes passing through your hands or torso won't count, so focus solely on dodging cubes targeting your head.

■Mind the Play Area Bounds!
Stepping outside the blue boundary frame results in an instant game over. Keep your steps, ducks, and dodges within the marked area.

■Mastering HARD Mode
Cube speed increases significantly in HARD mode! However, fewer cubes appear at once, so rely on quick judgment to survive.
